summary: Rosa, 70, lives with her husband on $2,400/month combined. Tests the seniors pathway against the Aged & Disabled FPL couple limit.
note: $2,400 is under the A&D FPL couple limit of $2,490/month (effective 2026-04-01). NOTE: A&D FPL compares countable income after disregards; screening on gross income is conservative, which is the safe direction — it can under-promise, never over-promise.
